item:
Motion simulated: `kerf simulate

` loads the URDF Kerf already exports into MuJoCo (pip `mujoco`, pinned) with real masses / inertias from the parts and catalog, servo torque and speed limits from the catalog; requirement kinds `grip_hold` (object of the stated mass / friction held under 1 g shake without slipping), `joint_speed` (move between poses within the stated time without exceeding servo torque) and `drop_impact` (peak contact force from a drop of the stated height, fed to fea_static as a load case); hand-checked tests (pendulum period, static holding torque); used by robot_arm and robotic_gripper_desk
